'''Utaruun''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Utaruun system/Legends|Utaruun system]], a part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Utaruun was located on the [[Old Corellian Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the [[Austan system/Legends|Austan]] and [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Utaruun originally served as a minor [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. When that [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route changed its course<ref name="TEA" /> at some point between [[11,000 BBY]] and [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]<ref name="OldCorellianRunDate" /> and as a result no longer ran through Utaruun, the world remained on the Old Corellian Run but became abandoned. During the [[Standard century/Legends|century]] leading up to<ref name="TEA" /> [[43 ABY]],<ref name="43 ABY">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which includes a description of Utaruun, ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> however, [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] began to move there.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Utaruun was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA" />
